source_observation: None of the clips sound remotely identical to the source; they are useful pieces of audio that sound influenced by the dataset.
common_artifact: Clip 02 has a jarring intro in both variants; not evidence of a LoRA-specific regression.
interpretation: Early subjective evidence of improved NAR rendering fidelity, especially high-end artifacts and fullness. Dataset-specific style acquisition and faithful source reconstruction have not been isolated.
workflow: Source excerpt -> ABC transcription plus source caption -> fresh AR semantic tokens -> fixed v9 NAR with or without learned step48 delta -> unchanged VAE. No source latents or audio-derived semantic tokens supplied.
controls: Semantic tokens identical within pairs; A/B listening copies RMS matched and share peak-prevention gain.
limits: One reviewer and one seed reviewed.
Two tracks were previous validation tracks.
The three long comparisons share one source track, also used for short clip 06.
Seeds 123 and 2026 remain unrated; do not infer their results.
